title: Reissert compound studies. LXIV. Reissert compound and other products from an isolated N‐benzoylisoquinolinium triflate salt
abstract: AbstractIn the presence of trimethylsilyl trifluoromethanesulfonate, a methylene chloride solution of isoquinoline and benzoyl chloride gave N‐benzoylisoquinolinium triflate (3) and N‐H‐isoquinolinium triflate (4). Depending on the reaction conditions, reaction of 3 may occur on the isoquinoline ring yielding a Reissert compound and 1,2‐dihydroisoquinoline species. Otherwise, reactions transpire on the carbonyl of 3 to give an amide, an ester, and an anhydride.
